_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil is statistically confirmed (0 of 74 windows moved ±2+ points) and the only visible breaker is fed_liquidity at 0 — until that spikes, accumulation chop is the base case and a forced directional guess would be a low-probability gamble.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes — both call HOLD with Anxiety as the phase; analyst is more cautious on positioning stress while narrative is more optimistic on the analog, but neither translates to a directional call.
next_move.confirmed_if: fed_liquidity breaks above 20 with btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d climbing above 85 (outflow acceleration = spot buying) and funding stays below 0.03%
next_move.invalidated_if: retail_noise_volume stays pinned at 100 while btc_momentum_30d rolls over below 50 and mvrv_zscore drops below 15 (distribution into weak hands, not accumulation)
